Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT UNARMED BODY SPRITE ATLAS, for modular equipment attachment in a Phaser isometric game.
Reference image1 establishes character identity only; reference image2 establishes existing game's isometric camera, upper-left lighting, painted/pre-rendered finish, realistic body proportions and restrained dark medieval tone.
CRITICAL: REMOVE ALL EQUIPMENT FROM THE BODY ART: NO AXE, NO KNIFE, NO TRIDENT, NO SHIELD, NO WEAPON FRAGMENTS, not even dropped equipment. Both EMPTY closed hands/gauntlets must be visible in EVERY pose, fingers curled as if gripping invisible handles. Bodies must be complete behind where equipment was. No extra arms, no extra hands.
Canvas: landscape 2048x1536. EXACT SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, eighteen equal cells (each 1/6 canvas width and 1/3 canvas height), one complete body per cell, no overlap. Generous transparent margins. Same body size and fixed foot midpoint within all cells. Feet baseline near cell local y460, body height about360. Actual transparent alpha, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no outlines or grid.
DIRECTION ROWS:
TOP row all six poses EAST, toward screen RIGHT, clear SIDE profile.
MIDDLE row all six poses SOUTH-EAST, down-right, clear FRONT-RIGHT 3/4 view with chest visible.
BOTTOM row all six poses NORTH-EAST, up-right AWAY, clear REAR-RIGHT 3/4 view with back visible, no face/visor seen.
POSE COLUMNS in each row:
0 idle guard with EMPTY gripping hands.
1 walk contact LEFT leg forward / RIGHT leg back.
2 walk contact RIGHT leg forward / LEFT leg back (CLEARLY OPPOSITE to column1), opposite arms.
3 attack WINDUP with distinctive torso/arm articulation.
4 attack CONTACT with distinctive extension and planted stance.
5 attack RECOVERY returning toward guard.
Keep design and scale identical across cells. Walk in place; no world translation. Weapons will be separate PNGs attached to hands, so EMPTY gripping hands and unoccluded arms are essential.
SUBJECT: Human skeleton, same mouth-shaped jagged iron mask with single black maw opening, exposed bone limbs and rib cage, ragged brown waist cloth. Two empty fists positioned COLLINEAR as if holding an invisible two-handed axe: in idle/walk one near hip and other forward across waist. In windup BOTH hands lifted ABOVE head and aligned on one invisible haft. Contact BOTH hands forward and down aligned on haft; recovery both hands low. No axe.
